questions.prompt: Four labels appear around a model text: a main title, a section heading, a figure caption, and a page footer. Which label should be marked to locate Advanced Grammar Review?
choices: The page footer beneath the passage
The main title above the opening paragraph
The figure caption below the flowchart
The section heading above the grammar examples
questions.explanation: The section heading above the grammar examples is where Advanced Grammar Review appears.
questions.skill: Distinguishing a section heading from other labels
questions.topic: Finding Advanced Grammar Review in a Model Text

questions.prompt: A model text is arranged in a two-by-two grid. The document title is in the upper-left cell, the introduction is in the lower-left cell, and the editing checklist is in the lower-right cell. Which cell contains Advanced Grammar Review?

questions.prompt: Four labeled hotspots sit over a diagram of the model text: H1 marks the introduction, H3 marks the Advanced Grammar Review, H5 marks the practice section, and H7 marks the conclusion. Which hotspot should be selected?

questions.prompt: A contents panel lists sections on sentence drills, advanced grammar, paragraph planning, and the drafting process. Which entry should be marked for the advanced grammar section?

questions.prompt: The model text presents four section headings in this order: Sentence Variety, Advanced Grammar Review, Paragraph Cohesion, and Editing Checklist. Which heading should be marked?
